name: Flight results
summary: A list of flight options: departure and arrival times and airports, the duration over a stops line, the airline as a drawn mark, the price, Best and Cheapest tags, and sort chips.
use: on a flight search results page, for comparing and choosing a flight
a11y: Sort chips are toggle buttons with aria-pressed, and each flight is one link whose name reads the whole flight (times, airports, duration, stops, price and tag); the drawn marks are decorative.

use_when: a short list of journeys of any kind where time, stops and price decide the pick
avoid_when: the pass for a flight already booked: use boarding-pass
the search form before results: use trip-search
hotel or home results: use stay-card

parts.name: summary
parts.what: date, travellers, cabin and how many flights are shown

parts.name: sort
parts.what: a sort chip with the best price and duration for that sort

parts.name: flights
parts.what: one flight option, a link to choose it

parts.name: path
parts.what: duration over a line with a dot per stop, then the stops

parts.name: arrive
parts.what: arrival time, with +1 for next day, and airport code

parts.name: airline
parts.what: a drawn airline mark, the airline name and a tag

parts.name: price
parts.what: price and what it is per

empty.how: with no flights, keep the heading and show empty-state ('No flights on this day') with a way to change the date

loading.how: keep the sort chips and show three flight cards with muted blocks where times, airline and price go

error.how: if the search fails, show alert-banners under the heading with a retry button in place of the list

disabled.how: for a sold-out flight, drop its link, dim the card and replace the price with 'Sold out'

overflow.how: the sort chips scroll sideways in their own row; on a phone each card stacks the route above the airline and price

long_text.how: a long airline name is cut with an ellipsis; times and prices never wrap
long_text.evidence: text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: var(--ds-text-label-lg)

keyboard: Tab reaches the three sort chips, then each flight link
Enter or Space on a sort chip re-sorts the list and marks that chip pressed
Enter on a flight follows its link
